fixed.summary: The cook's "albedo baked into emission" warning no longer flags painted glow maps. With a base-colour map of the same size beside it, an emissive map is flagged only when it glows on at least half its texels and repeats the base colour there; glowing lines, seams and veins over a surface of another colour are not. Without one, the mean-luminance rule is unchanged.

A model program's painted surface counts the palette it was mixed from (each part's colour, each layer's colour and emission) against the look's `ArtPalette.maxColors`, not every shaded texel of its maps, so a textured prop no longer reports `overColours` by thousands.
